sources.used_for: IS_PENDING hides incomplete items from other applications; OWNER_PACKAGE_NAME and RELATIVE_PATH are explicitly checked. Owner queries have Android 14+ visibility constraints.
App-owned MediaStore insertion, pending lifecycle and descriptor-based output. No broad storage permission workaround is used.
Update returns a row count; a subsequent fallible read is a separate operation, so an unconfirmed outcome must not be represented as proof that no photo was published.

recovery_scope: Actual separate-process host crash recovery plus production Android code and primary API/source review; no phone gallery claim.
